column1: # OptiScaler.ini 注释汉化词典 C（枚举列表 / 代码示例）
0 = Default | 1 = A | 2 = B | 3 = C | 4 = D | 5 = E
0 = FSR1 | 1 = Bicubic | 2 = Catmull-Rom | 3 = Lanczos2 | 4 = Lanczos3 | 5 = Kaiser2 | 6 = Kaiser3 | 7 = MAGIC
0 = For FSR Native AA, 1 = Ultra Quality/Quality, 2 = Balanced, 3 = Performance, 4 = DRS, 5 = Ultra Performance
column2: 0 = FSR 原生 AA，1 = 超级质量/质量，2 = 均衡，3 = 性能，4 = DRS，5 = 超级性能

column1: 0 = Just FPS | 1 = Simple | 2 = Detailed | 3 = Detailed + Graph | 4 Full | 5 Full + Graph | 6 Reflex timings
column2: 0 = 仅 FPS | 1 = 简洁 | 2 = 详细 | 3 = 详细 + 曲线 | 4 = 完整 | 5 = 完整 + 曲线 | 6 = Reflex 计时

column1: 0 = KPSS | 1 = Splat | 2 = Model 3 | 3 = Model 4 | 4 = Model 5 | 5 = Model 6
column2: 0 = KPSS | 1 = Splat | 2 = 模型 3 | 3 = 模型 4 | 4 = 模型 5 | 5 = 模型 6

column1: 0 = Top Left | 1 = Top Right | 2 = Bottom Left | 3 Bottom Right
column2: 0 = 左上 | 1 = 右上 | 2 = 左下 | 3 = 右下

column1: 1 = aggressive, will improve latency but in some cases will lower fps more than expected
column2: 1 = 激进，可改善延迟，但某些情况下帧数下降幅度会超出预期

column1: 2 = use reflex frame ids, some games are not compatible (i.e. cyberpunk) and will fallback to aggressive
column2: 2 = 使用 Reflex 帧 ID，部分游戏不兼容（如《赛博朋克》），将回退为激进模式

column1: For example to use Nukems in a game that only has upscaling: FGInput=upscaler, FGOutput=dlssg, FGNvngxReplacement=Nukems
column2: 例如，要在仅有超分的游戏中使用 Nukems：FGInput=upscaler, FGOutput=dlssg, FGNvngxReplacement=Nukems

column1: If you want to use e.g. VK_BACK/Backspace key, that would be 0x08 - set ShortcutKey=0x08
column2: 例如要使用 VK_BACK/Backspace 键，其值为 0x08 - 设置 ShortcutKey=0x08

column1: Nvngx FG is the lower level DLSSG provider. FGInput=NvngxFG or FGOutput=DLSSG need to be used for this setting to do anything
column2: Nvngx FG 是更底层的 DLSSG 提供方。需要设置 FGInput=NvngxFG 或 FGOutput=DLSSG，此项才会生效

column1: Path to a font to be used as HQ Font, requires UseHQFont=true
column2: 用作高质量字体的字体路径，需要 UseHQFont=true

column1: To use Arturs in a game that already supports DLSSG: FGInput=nvngxfg, FGOutput=auto, FGNvngxReplacement=Arturs
column2: 要在已支持 DLSSG 的游戏中使用 Arturs：FGInput=nvngxfg, FGOutput=auto, FGNvngxReplacement=Arturs
